verdict.rationale: 2FAS Auth explicitly states it 'works offline' and generates TOTP codes on iOS, Android and the browser extension. It is described as local-first, and cloud sync is optional through the user's own iCloud or Google Drive, so viewing codes does not depend on network or vendor services. The browser extension needs no login or password. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that the 2FAS Auth mobile app needs no account or registration (the 'no registration' claim is for 2FAS Pass), and independent or hands-on confirmation of airplane-mode code generation.

support.subject: As a power user, codes generate fully offline — no network, no vendor account required just to see my TOTP codes

citations.quote: Generate TOTP, HOTP and Steam Guard codes on iOS, Android and via browser extensions.
You can enable secure data syncing with your personal iCloud or Google Drive to protect yourself from losing Tokens in case of phone damage or loss.
the browser extension does not require nor need any login or password.
